# Manage topics

This command is a compatibility alias for `/manage-topics`. Re-read
`.github/prompts/manage-topics.prompt.md` and `src/skills/manage-topics/SKILL.md`
from disk on every invocation and follow the canonical experience.

Preserve the maker's original request, selected target, action, topic sets and
caller context. Do not ask them to switch commands, repeat the request or
confirm the rename. Use **Manage topics** as the skill name and use the same
helpers, fresh review and explicit approval contract as `/manage-topics`.
